lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the branchial region. A primary row of approximately 6-8 equidistant nodes is located along the mid-lateral line, with parallel rows above and below exhibiting a structured grid-like arrangement.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition. The primary ridge follows the dorsal-lateral curvature, while two secondary ridges run parallel towards the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of approximately 12-15 high-luminance blobs. These are non-uniformly distributed, with a higher concentration observed near the base and trailing edge of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density, stochastic cluster of smaller high-luminance spots is visible on the cranial/dorsal-head region, contrasting with the structured geometric grid of the posterior lateral flank.
